arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# CY2010
net_individual_income_taxes_2010 = 898549  # in millions
total_receipts_2010 = 2161728  # in millions

# CY2011
net_individual_income_taxes_2011 = 1091473  # in millions
total_receipts_2011 = 2302495  # in millions

# Calculate percent contribution for each year
percent_2010 = (net_individual_income_taxes_2010 / total_receipts_2010) * 100
percent_2011 = (net_individual_income_taxes_2011 / total_receipts_2011) * 100

print(f'CY2010 percent contribution: {percent_2010:.2f}%')
print(f'CY2011 percent contribution: {percent_2011:.2f}%')

# Calculate change
change = percent_2011 - percent_2010
print(f'Change in percent contribution: {change:.2f} percentage points')
"
